stage.name: Clash of Ideologies
stage.description:
Condition:

<Crownslayer> Special ability cooldown reduced

<Patriot> Throw spear cooldown reduced

<Mephisto Singer> Toxic dust damage increased

<Mandragora> Mandragora's Gaze damage increased

dublinn_phalanx_infantry.name: Dublinn Phalanx Infantry
dublinn_phalanx_infantry.flavourText: A phalanx infantry in the Dublinn forces. The phalanx tactics they utilize evolved from the combat formations used in Gaul. In the phalanx, nearby infantry will support one another, increasing the might of the formation.
abilities: When other Phalanx Infantry are nearby, DEF increases (stacks)
Refraction

possessed_soldier_leader.name: Possessed Soldier Leader
possessed_soldier_leader.flavourText: A soldier that has been controlled by an unknown entity, capable of regenerating rapidly and more dangerous than a normal Possessed Soldier. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.
abilities: Regenerates HP over time.

guerrilla_fighter_leader.name: Guerrilla Fighter Leader
guerrilla_fighter_leader.flavourText: A veteran guerilla fighter. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain increased capabilities and utilize a full range of offensive maneuvers.
abilities: When Inspired, gains Movement Speed.

sarkaz_blademaster.name: Sarkaz Blademaster
sarkaz_blademaster.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary, more skilled than an ordinary Sarkaz Swordsman. Though scarred by years of war, they are still fighting to fulfill the orders of their employers.

possessed_veteran_junkman.name: Possessed Veteran Junkman
possessed_veteran_junkman.flavourText: A Veteran Junkman that has been controlled by an unknown entity, capable of regenerating rapidly. Covered with clusters of Originium. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.
abilities: Regenerates HP over time.

guerrilla_sniper_leader.name: Guerrilla Sniper Leader
guerrilla_sniper_leader.flavourText: A veteran guerilla sniper who has extensive professional, military-grade sharpshooting skills. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain increased capabilities and attack two targets at once.
abilities: When Inspired, attacks one additional target.

dublinn_scout_leader.name: Dublinn Scout Leader
dublinn_scout_leader.flavourText: A scout leader in the Dublinn forces. The scouts under their command are the cornerstone of the Dublinn forces' guerilla maneuvers. Equipped with a refractive mask crafted by Shadowcasters, they are rather resistant to regular Originium Arts.
abilities: Refraction

sponsor_drone.name: Sponsor Drone
sponsor_drone.flavourText: Ellen Select Technology thanks you for your sponsorship! This quick and affordable drone carries the passion of the fans, bringing anything to the knights on the field: traps, explosives, medicine, or even snacks! The outcome of the battle is in your hands!
abilities: Flying unit.
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter
When destroyed, grants a deployable unit

enraged_tombkeeper_grotesque.name: Enraged Tombkeeper Grotesque
enraged_tombkeeper_grotesque.flavourText: A special Arts creation from the Dublinn forces, created by their leader Mandragora. According to Mandragora, back when she was studying Originium Arts in an outskirts cemetery, the Tombkeeper Grotesque was her first companion. Its outer appearance has gone through many redesigns, with the latest being based off a Sarkaz from an ancient bloodline. This series of Tombkeepers embodies Mandragora's fury towards Victoria.
abilities: After first defeat, temporarily transforms into a stone statue with extremely high DEF, then revives as an aerial unit
Refraction

enraged_possessed_bonethrower.name: Enraged Possessed Bonethrower
enraged_possessed_bonethrower.flavourText: An enemy ranged combatant who has completely given in to primal madness as their lifeforce is consumed. The infection has penetrated their bone marrow, they will even rip out the Originium lodged inside their bodies to throw because of their deadened sense of pain. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.
abilities: Will gradually lose HP over time

enraged_possessed_leader.name: Enraged Possessed Leader
enraged_possessed_leader.flavourText: An enemy combatant who has completely given in to primal madness as their lifeforce is consumed. The infection has penetrated their bone marrow, and their death-defying aggression breaks the bounds of reason. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.
abilities: Will gradually lose HP over time

sarkaz_bladeweaver_leader.name: Sarkaz Bladeweaver Leader
sarkaz_bladeweaver_leader.flavourText: An elite Sarkaz mercenary who has mastered the combination of swordsmanship and Arts. The Originium flowing through their blood allows them to hold these crudely modified Arts-imbued greatswords. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they are capable of dealing melee attacks that inflict Arts damage while in Combat-Ready mode.
abilities: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and inflicts Arts damage with melee attacks.

guerrilla_shieldguard.name: Guerrilla Shieldguard
guerrilla_shieldguard.flavourText: One of Patriot's elite defenders. Carrying out Patriot's will, these shieldguards form the solid foundation of the 'Aegis of the Infected.' Equipped with high-performance protective armor, they cover for their comrades by drawing fire from enemies while present on the battlefield.
abilities: More likely to be targeted by attacks.

sarkaz_guerrilla_fighter_leader.name: Sarkaz Guerrilla Fighter Leader
sarkaz_guerrilla_fighter_leader.flavourText: A Sarkaz fighter who boasts greater destructive power, but cannot understand the special terminology of their guerilla operations. The Sarkaz ritual maintained by the Sarkaz Originium Altars will not damage them, instead strengthening their bodies and converting their attacks into Arts damage.
abilities: When coming into contact with a Pulse Wave, this unit instead takes no damage and will deal Arts damage with normal attacks.

demolitionist.name: Demolitionist
demolitionist.flavourText: A high-level elite Reunion combatant who wears heavy-duty, explosion-proof protective gear. Their special Originium-powered hammers have massive destructive range, and must be dealt with cautiously.
abilities: Attacks cause an explosion, dealing Splash damage to units around the primary target.

dublinn_heavy_defender_leader.name: Dublinn Heavy Defender Leader
dublinn_heavy_defender_leader.flavourText: A heavy defender leader in the Dublinn forces, they wield much more sophisticated equipment. The armor technology they use comes from Victoria, while their boots were designed in Leithanien. Their shields look extremely similar to a newly patented product from Kazimierz's Roar Guards Company.
abilities: Refraction

guerrilla_mortar_leader.name: Guerrilla Mortar Leader
guerrilla_mortar_leader.flavourText: The cream of the crop among Patriot's elite suppression troops. Compared to ordinary mortars, these troops equip more dangerous and destructive shells. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain greatly increased combat capabilities and have significantly increased attack speed.
abilities: When Inspired, gains greatly increased ASPD.

crownslayer.name: Crownslayer
crownslayer.flavourText: One of Reunion's squad leaders who handles infiltration and assassination operations, specializing in melee combat and breaking through defensive lines. Her stealth and superb infiltration abilities have foiled countless attempts to capture her.
abilities: When blocked, can quickly move behind the unit

mandragora.name: Mandragora
mandragora.flavourText: One of the leaders of the Dublinn forces, a caster who controls stone. Emerging from the darkness of Victoria, she has sworn to repay the humiliation she suffered at the hands of the nobles manyfold.
abilities: [Stoneshield] Reduces damage taken; temporarily loses effect after being hit by a Tattered Pillar
First Form
[Mandragora's Gaze] Targets the unit with the highest ATK within range, dealing Arts damage and reducing their ASPD. If the target is retreated or defeated, destroy the tile the unit is on
Second Form
[Stoneshield] Grants Low-Altitude Hovering, and continuously deals Arts damage to units within range
Periodically knocks down Tattered Pillars
Uses [Mandragora's Gaze] more frequently

mephisto_the_singer.name: Mephisto, 'The Singer'
mephisto_the_singer.flavourText: You seem to recognize the mysterious, mythical beast that has descended from the Sarcophagus. An otherworldly song flows from its sharp beak and floods its surroundings. It seems to devour the will of the Infected around it, including its own. Even if it knows not what it is doing, its song does not cease. It simply wishes to sing.
abilities: Activated Form
When Activated, heals and strengthens an enemy Host unit
Each time a certain percentage of HP is lost, releases toxic dust across the entire battlefield that lasts for 30s and can stack
The first time HP drops to 0, enters a Dormant State for a period of time
Dormant State
Gains increased DEF and RES, and continuously recovers HP

patriot.name: Patriot
patriot.flavourText: His armor is in disrepair and damaged in many places. The blade of his once sharp halberd is now eroded with rust. However, the indomitable Patriot never capitulates, never backs down, and never shows mercy. He has long struggled with fate, and now resolves to slit the throat of fate.
abilities: Greatly increases the ATK and DEF of enemy units
Marching Stance
Gains greatly increased ATK, DEF, and RES. Becomes more likely to be targeted by your units, and normal attacks strike 4 times
Enters a revival state when HP drops to 0, continuously dealing True damage to units around him. After a period of time, enters Ruination stance
Ruination Stance
Can perform long-ranged attacks
Deals Physical damage to the farthest high ground unit
Continuously deals True damage to allied units within range
Immune to Stun, Frozen, and Levitate
